The '''Subsidiary Corporate Complex''' was the [[pressure]] in [[A'Lenba]] shared by the various smaller corporations. [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]] provided security, but were assisted by a detachment of [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] security personnel.
